Recent milestones
Things worth celebrating this quarter
View all
OCT 14, 2024
Hartwell Foundation grant approved

$45,000 over 18 months for the Family Pantry expansion — the largest single grant in our history.

OCT 09, 2024
Crossed 2,000 people served

Our cumulative reach passed two thousand neighbors this fiscal year, three weeks ahead of plan.

SEP 28, 2024
First Bright Futures cohort graduated

All 24 students completed the after-school literacy program — 22 advanced a reading level.

SEP 15, 2024
Autumn appeal exceeded its goal

317 donors gave a combined $28,940 — 116% of the $25,000 target. Average gift was $91.

SEP 02, 2024
New partnership with Cedar Health Clinic

Referral pathway now connects pantry visitors to free wellness screenings every other Saturday.

AUG 21, 2024
Volunteer milestone: 100 active helpers

Reached one hundred active volunteers for the first time, with 38 returning every week.
